meta.title: Regency Lodge, Sharm El Sheikh | Book your room direct
meta.desc: Twenty double rooms around the pool in El Hadaba, Sharm El Sheikh. From EGP {price} per room per night. See which rooms are free and book direct; pay on arrival.

hero.h1: A room on the pool, EGP {price} a night.
hero.lead: Twenty rooms, all the same kind, and three plain prices. Pick your dates and see which keys are still hanging on the board.

rack.few: Last room for your dates|Last {n} rooms for your dates

rack.short: Only {n} free on these dates. Ask for fewer rooms or change the dates.

photo.pool: The pool with the rooms looking onto it
photo.caption: The pool sits in the middle of the lodge, and every room looks onto it.

plans.title: Three prices, nothing hidden
plans.lead: Per room, per night, in Egyptian pounds. Choose what suits you.

folio.title: Your bill
folio.pay: Pay on arrival. Nothing is charged now.

room.title: The room
room.lead: A standard double room looking onto the pool. All twenty rooms are the same kind, so there are no surprises when you arrive.
room.bedV: One double or two singles, your choice
room.planAlt: The room drawn from above: beds, wardrobe, minibar, television and the door onto the pool
room.alt1: Room with two beds, wardrobe and television
room.alt2: Room with two beds and two windows

around.title: A short walk away
around.lead: Walking times from the lodge door.
around.airport: Sharm El Sheikh International Airport is 15.6 km by car.

direct.title: Why book here?
direct.aT: What you see here is what you hear on the phone and what you pay at reception.
direct.bT: We hold your room at once, and you pay on arrival.
direct.cT: You talk to reception directly, not to an agent.
